subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park legacy ownerless outbox rows for manual recovery rather than replaying or silently discarding them under the newly resolved chat owner?
rationale: This is a deliberate persisted-state compatibility choice: either behavior can affect existing queued messages, and repository policy requires explicit acceptance for the schema-version and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Accept fail-closed recovery
options.body: Keep ambiguous rows visible but non-retryable, require re-entry or deletion, and verify the version-4-to-8 migration and recovery UI before merge.

options.title: Preserve automatic retry
options.body: Design an owner-safe migration or compatibility path that can prove the original agent before allowing legacy rows to replay.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Land only the transient composer isolation and defer cache/outbox schema changes until the persisted-state contract is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ambiguous rows visible but non-retryable, require re-entry or deletion, and verify the version-4-to-8 migration and recovery UI before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the ownership and migration expansion and are best positioned to confirm that the fail-closed upgrade contract is intentional.
